description: This file defines the StreamRequestPayloadMiddleware class, which is a middleware component used for handling streaming payloads in AWS SDK requests. It manages request headers related to payload content length and transfer encoding based on the command and service operation details.

classes.name: StreamRequestPayloadMiddleware
classes.description: This class functions as a middleware in the AWS SDK, handling streaming payloads by adjusting request headers based on streaming activity and payload size requirements.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function for a given service, returning a closure that initializes the middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a next handler callable and a service instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the request by inspecting the command and operation, adding appropriate headers for streaming payloads, and passing the request to the next middleware.
